run_get_active_tasks_stats: run the debug endpoint to get active asyncio task counts grouped by coroutine name
run_get_memory_summary: run the debug endpoint to get a simplified memory usage summary with health status and cache counts
run_get_memory_details: run the debug endpoint to get detailed memory diagnostics including GC stats, object types, and cache sizes
run_configure_gc_thresholds: run the debug endpoint to configure Python garbage collection thresholds at runtime
run_init_verbose_loggers: run the helper function to set verbose log levels based on WORKER_CONFIG settings
